basic_details.job_title: Uttarakhand High Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 18 Counsellor, General Counsellor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital will engage 18 Counsellors on contract in Family Courts of Uttarakhand: 1 General Counsellor, 16 Counsellors and 1 Child Counsellor, at a monthly honorarium of ₹50,000 plus ₹10,000 travel allowance (₹60,000 per month in all). The application form with self-attested copies must be sent only by Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier, and applications received through email will not be entertained. Applications received after 11 December 2026 and the prescribed time will not be entertained.

important_instructions: The list of shortlisted candidates and the schedule of interview-interaction will be notified on the official website of the High Court of Uttarakhand; candidates are advised to visit the website regularly. The place, date and mode of interview will be notified separately by the High Court. Incomplete applications, or applications not conforming to any prescribed requirements, are liable to rejection; no correspondence will be entertained. No TA/DA is payable for appearing in the interview-interaction. The engagement is contractual and governed by the terms and conditions prescribed by the State Government and applicable Government Orders. Submission of an application does not confer any right to engagement or appointment. The recruitment process may be modified or cancelled, in whole or in part, without assigning any reason. If information in the form is found false or a material fact is concealed, the candidature-engagement is liable to cancellation.

Therapy certificate, or Psychologist/Psychiatrist, or MSW, or 10 years of combined experience (post-wise details below)
Family Courts in Dehradun, Haridwar, Nainital, Pauri Garhwal, U.S. Nagar and Uttarkashi districts
11.12.2026 (applications received after the last date and time are not entertained)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form can be downloaded from the official website of the High Court, https://highcourtofuttarakhand.gov.in . The same form is printed at the end of the notice. The duly completed form, in the prescribed format, must go with self-attested copies of all requisite documents. Mode: only Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier. Email: any application form received through email will not be entertained. Envelope: write on it “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT AS [NAME OF POST] IN THE FAMILY COURT”. Postal address: not specified in the notice. Last date: 11.12.2026; applications received after the prescribed last date and time will not be entertained under any circumstances. The form asks for the Family Court(s) and post(s) applied for, in order of preference (up to three lines). It also asks for personal details, address, mobile number and email ID, educational qualifications, professional experience, NGO experience, identity proof, present occupation, nationality and gender (optional), and any other relevant qualification. The form has questions on criminal cases, charge-sheets, convictions, more than one living spouse and any disqualification, and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 18 posts carry the same pay. Each Family Court has one post, as listed below. The candidate should not be above 65 years of age as on the last date prescribed for submission of the application. The candidate must be a citizen of India. The notice prints no age relaxation. Any one of the following: Certificate holder in Couple and Family Therapy; or a Psychologist; or Master of Social Work (MSW) from a University recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC); or a person having at least 10 years of combined experience in counselling, mediation, family matters, matrimonial disputes and other related matters. Certificate in Couple and Family Therapy; or a qualified Psychiatrist/Psychologist; or Master of Social Work (MSW) from a UGC-recognised University; or a person having at least 10 years of combined experience in counselling, mediation, family matters, matrimonial disputes and other related matters. Post Graduate Certificate in Couple and Family Therapy; or a qualified Psychiatrist/Psychologist; or Master of Social Work (MSW) from a UGC-recognised University; or a person having at least 10 years of combined experience in counselling, mediation, family matters, matrimonial disputes and other related matters. Preference shall be given to candidates having experience of working with Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs) and in the fields of matrimonial matters, matters relating to children and senior citizens, or with persons facing mental health issues. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Uttarakhand High Court Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The job profile is printed once for all three posts (Counsellors, General Counsellors and Child Counsellors): Undertake counselling in matrimonial disputes and matters relating to women and children, senior citizens and persons with mental health issues, as may be assigned by the concerned Family Court. Assist couples in understanding the sources of their conflicts. Identify behavioural patterns contributing to disputes. Facilitate resolution of such disputes.

Self-attested copy of document in support of date of birth. Self-attested copies of experience certificates/documents. Self-attested copies of any other relevant documents in support of the application.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in Uttarakhand High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 posts: 1 General Counsellor, 16 Counsellors and 1 Child Counsellor, one in each listed Family Court.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 11.12.2026. Applications received after the prescribed last date and time will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Counsellor?
faq.answer: A Counsellor needs a certificate in Couple and Family Therapy, or to be a Psychologist, or an MSW from a UGC-recognised university, or at least 10 years of combined experience in counselling, mediation and related family matters.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be above 65 years of age as on the last date prescribed for submission of the application, and must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is ₹50,000 along with ₹10,000 per month as travel allowance, ₹60,000 per month in all, subject to applicable Government Orders and terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply by email?
faq.answer: No. The form must be sent only by Speed Post, Registered Post or Courier, and any application received through email will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT AS [NAME OF POST] IN THE FAMILY COURT”, replacing the bracket with the post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A nominated Selection Committee selects through personal interview-interaction and may shortlist applications first. It prepares a panel and a waiting list of three candidates per post.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contractual basis, and submitting an application does not confer any right to engagement or appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is payable for appearing in the interview-interaction.
